description: Virtual 3D Model of the South Harbour in Helsinki 2011 is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. 3D vector model of the Helsinki South Harbour ideas competition 2011. The dataset was produced as the initial data for the international ideas competition organised by the Helsinki City Planning Department from 2 May to 30 September 2011. Coverage: Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The publisher named on the listing is Helsingin kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include mallit, 3D-mallit. The listing shows 1 download or service links in DWG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
